_doc: Patterns the writing check flags. weight >= 1 is a strong tell that agents must fix; weaker ones only matter in clusters. pattern is a case-insensitive regex.

rules.label: Not just X, it's Y
rules.pattern: \b(not just|isn['’]t just|wasn['’]t just|aren['’]t just|not only|not merely|not simply|more than just)\b
rules.fix: Drop the 'not X' half and say the point directly.

rules.label: Em dash
rules.fix: Use a period or a comma.

rules.label: Hype word
rules.fix: Use a plain word, or cut it.

rules.label: Excited / eager / love to
rules.fix: Say what you want to do and why, without the feeling-word.

rules.label: Template opener or closer
rules.pattern: \b(hope (this|you['’]re) (finds you|doing) well|looking forward to hearing from you|thank you for your time and consideration|please don['’]t hesitate)\b
rules.fix: Cut it; start with the point and end with a specific ask.

rules.label: Colon reveal
rules.pattern: \b(here['’]s the (thing|kicker|deal)|the result|the best part|the truth|the secret|the answer)\s*:

rules.label: And/But/So opener
rules.fix: Fine now and then; connect it to the sentence before if there are several.

rules.label: List of three
rules.fix: Check whether all three earn their place.
